description: What a source's finding becomes: the condition type, status and reason, whether it is a sum of others, whether it is heard. A record re-rates, routes or quiets a failing finding; it never makes one ok and never touches an ok.

records.description: An open alert is a warning on what it is about: the mail went, a rule never fails the site.
The alerts that say something is exposed are threat warnings.
A threat hit at warning holds for a day from its last hit (ADR-050 D12): an attack still going keeps it open.
A threat hit at critical holds until someone acknowledges it with a reason (ADR-050 D12); a new hit opens it again.
A zone's and an environment's CVE score is the sum of their modules': never a root.
A module whose CVE level only the NixOS baseline sets is not a root of its own: the site's one baseline finding is.
An operational warning nobody dealt with for a day becomes critical.
